articles.title: CrowdStrike Makes AI Security Push With Blockbuster Zscaler Deal
articles.summary: CrowdStrike's $44 billion acquisition of Zscaler would unite endpoint protection and zero-trust network security to obtain greater control over AI agents.

articles.title: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler for $43.9 billion
articles.summary: CrowdStrike has agreed to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock deal with an enterprise value of about $43.9 billion. Deal terms Zscaler shareholders will receive 1.135 CrowdStrike shares for each Zscaler share. Based on CrowdStrike’s November 20, 2026 closing price, that implies approximately $260.41 per Zscaler share, a premium of roughly 34% over Zscaler’s closing share price on the same date.
